verdicts.title: Bi-partite entanglement entropy in massive 1+1-dimensional quantum field theories
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This manuscript is a review of the main results obtained in a series of papers involving the present authors and their collaborator J.L. Cardy over the last two years. In our work we have developed and applied a new approach for the computation of the bi-partite entanglement entropy in massive 1+1-dimensional quantum field theories. verdicts.title: Multi-strategy Based Quantum Cost Reduction of Quantum Boolean Circuits
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The construction of quantum computers is based on the synthesis of low-cost quantum circuits. The quantum circuit of any Boolean function expressed in a Positive Polarity Reed-Muller $PPRM$ expansion can be synthesized using Multiple-Control Toffoli ($MCT$) gates.
